about_what_body: In managed mode VirtualAP hands the hotspot to an OpenWrt container and leaves its bridge, vap-br0, without an address, so the phone itself is not on the hotspot network. NyxBridge gives the phone an address there and adds the routing rule Android needs, so apps like LocalSend can reach hotspot devices.
about_what_cleanup: It only acts while VirtualAP runs in managed mode, and removes everything it added when the hotspot stops.
about_credits_virtualap: VirtualAP by ravindu644 creates the hotspot and the managed-mode bridge NyxBridge attaches to.
about_credits_droidspaces: Droidspaces by ravindu644 runs the OpenWrt container that owns the hotspot network.
about_credits_lanip: The idea of a low-priority routing rule for the hotspot subnet comes from studying droidspaces-lan-ip by yashoswalyo and VirtualAP’s routed mode. NyxBridge’s code is its own.
about_credits_nyx: The WebUI shares its framework with NyxSUSFS and NyxProps. Issues and translations welcome.
